title: Austin Executive Session: Land, Law, Staff
summary:
*   A special meeting was held, primarily taking place behind closed doors in an "Executive Session."
*   Discussions covered important city matters including potential land purchases, ongoing legal issues, and staffing decisions.
*   No public votes or official policy decisions were made during this particular session, which concluded after the closed-door discussions.
transcript:

MAIN LIBRARY
Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas
- SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
City Council

Memorandum To:
Mayor Cooksey called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the
absence of Councllmember Rose.
EXECUTIVE SESSION
The Mayor announced Council would enter into Executive Session, pursuant to Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated to discuss matters of land acquisition,
litigation and personnel matters; no official action will be taken on any of these matters
unless such item is specifically listed on the agenda. RECESS AND ADJOURNMENT Council
recessed its meeting for executive session and. adjourned its meeting at 6:20 p.m.
